svg.title: GitOps delivery
svg.text: Git is the only way in: Argo CD installs and keeps every operator and chart in line with it
Helm charts plus layered values: base, then
make helm-check renders every environment and
make gitops-push mirrors the tree to in-
cluster Gitea as a signed commit
Root app of apps, ApplicationSets for
operators and platform; picks the change up
One Argo CD project per layer, default project
Manual kubectl changes are undone; make
RECORDED RUN EVIDENCE / NOT A LIVE STATUS CHECK
Historical Phase 5 bootstrap: 6 / 6 applications Synced and Healthy, data intact. This is not the current application count. · One chart set for kind and EKS;
values differ. · Push to sync: < 1 min in the recorded run.
